name: rosetta-hamming-numbers
code:
use default

let two = 2n
let three = 3n
let five = 5n

let hamming = LIST([1n])
let next_two mut = 0
let next_three mut = 0
let next_five mut = 0

while hamming.count < 1000000 do
    let by_two = two * hamming[next_two]
    let by_three = three * hamming[next_three]
    let by_five = five * hamming[next_five]

    let best = if bigint.compare(by_two, by_three) < 0
               then by_two else by_three fi
    let next = if bigint.compare(by_five, best) < 0
               then by_five else best fi

    hamming.add(next)

    if by_two =~ next then next_two = next_two + 1; fi
    if by_three =~ next then next_three = next_three + 1; fi
    if by_five =~ next then next_five = next_five + 1; fi
od

write_line(hamming |> take(20) |> join(" "))
write_line("1691st: {hamming[1690]}")
write_line("1000000th: {hamming[999999]}")
